newsitem.title: UK: Poll gives UK's Labour 32-point lead in London.
newsitem.headline: Poll gives UK's Labour 32-point lead in London.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party enjoys a gaping 32 percent lead over the ruling Conservatives in London, a poll conducted for the Evening Standard by MORI shows.
Labour is backed by 59 percent of London's voters while just 27 percent support the Conservatives, the poll shows. The minority Liberal Democrats languish on 10 percent.
Labour's lead in the capital has increased by six points since the last London poll was carried out in October, the Evening Standard said.
If the figures were reflected in voting patterns at the May 1 general election, the Conservatives would lose 32 of the 41 seats they currently hold in Britain's capital city.
A national poll by MORI, released earlier on Thursday, put Labour's countrywide lead at 27 percent. But the day before, an ICM poll for the Guardian newspaper said that gap was just 14 percent.
